transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you here today?

Hi, doctor. Thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm doing this right. 

Um... I guess they brought me in because of some things happening at the warehouse where I work. It's really not a huge deal, I promise, I'm not trying to be a bad worker or anything. It's just... sometimes I get kind of stuck, like I'll freeze with my arms up in the air by the forklift. And I guess I sort of copy the beeping noises it makes, and the hand signals the other guys do. 

I also was moving the boxes into these, um, special little patterns. It made sense to me at the time, but... well, even when everyone was yelling for me to stop, I just kept doing it. I really didn't mean to upset anyone or cause a scene. Does that make sense? I hope I'm not in too much trouble.
Have you ever felt like things around you don’t seem real, or like you’re watching yourself from outside your body?

Um, no... no, I don't think I've ever felt like that. I'm always just, you know, right here in my own body. Everything feels pretty real to me. 

I mean, I hope that's the right answer. Is it... is it a good thing that I don't have that happening? I really want to be helpful and do this right, so just let me know if I'm not explaining things the way you need me to.
Do you ever feel like you have to do certain things over and over again, even if you don’t want to, because it just feels like you have to?

Um, no... I don't think I get anything like that. 

I mean, I know I told you about putting the boxes into patterns earlier, but... I didn't feel like I *had* to do it against my will, you know? It just... it just seemed like the right way to organize them at the time. I definitely wasn't trying to be difficult or obsessive about it, I promise. 

So, no, I don't feel forced to repeat things if I don't want to. I hope that's an okay answer? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need, so please let me know if I should explain it better.
Do you ever find yourself making sudden, unexpected movements or sounds that you can’t control, like blinking, shrugging, or blurting out words?

Oh, um... no. I don't think I do anything like that. No sudden twitches or... or blurting things out. 

I mean, I know I mentioned making the forklift noises earlier, but that wasn't... it wasn't like a sudden spasm or me just yelling words out of nowhere, I promise. I really try to be respectful and quiet around the other guys at the warehouse. So, no, I don't have any uncontrollable movements like that. 

I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information, so please tell me if I'm doing okay.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy, even when things aren’t stressful at work?

Um, no... I don't think I've been feeling down like that. I mean, work can be tiring sometimes, just being on my feet moving freight all day, but I'm not... I don't feel hopeless or anything. I still like doing my usual stuff when I'm off the clock. 

I really try to keep a positive attitude, you know? I don't want to cause any trouble or bring anyone else down by being sad. So, no, I'm doing okay in that department. 

Is... is that a good thing? I hope I'm giving you the right answers. I just really want to make sure I'm doing this right for you, so please let me know if I'm doing okay.
Have you ever had thoughts come into your mind that you can’t seem to get rid of, even though you wish you could and they bother you?

Um, no, not really. I don't get thoughts stuck in my head like that. 

I mean, sometimes my mind wanders a bit when I'm just moving pallets around, but it's nothing bad or... or anything that bothers me. I definitely don't have any weird or upsetting thoughts that I can't shake off. I try to keep my mind on the job and just focus on doing good work, you know? I wouldn't want to be distracted by things like that.

So, no, my thoughts are pretty normal, I think. I hope that's what you were asking? I just want to make sure I'm answering everything the way you need me to. Am I doing alright?
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others around you don’t seem to notice, like hearing voices or seeing things that aren’t there?

Um, no, definitely not. I don't hear voices or... or see anything that isn't really there. 

I mean, the warehouse can get super loud with all the equipment, so sometimes I might mishear a coworker shouting over a pallet jack or something, but that's just normal stuff. I promise I don't imagine things. I really wouldn't want you to think I was... you know, making things up or losing touch with reality or anything. My head is totally clear, I swear. 

Is that... does that help? I really want to make sure I'm giving you what you need, so I hope I'm doing a good job for you.
Have you ever felt like your body was frozen or stiff, like you couldn’t move even if you wanted to, or the opposite—like you couldn’t stop moving even when you tried?

Um... well... I guess maybe sometimes I get a little stuck? But it's not like I'm frozen or anything bad like that. 

I think... well, I guess the reason they brought me in is because of some stuff at the warehouse. Like, sometimes I'll be by the forklift and I just sort of... pause with my arms up. And I might, you know, copy the beeping sounds it makes or do the hand signals the drivers use. Or sometimes I'll move the boxes around in these... I don't know, just little patterns that make sense to me. 

People get kind of mad and yell at me to stop, which makes me feel really awful because I don't want to upset anyone or slow down the line. I try to stop when they yell, I really do, but sometimes my body just kind of keeps doing it for a minute. 

It's just me trying to do a good job and be part of the rhythm of the warehouse, you know? I really hope that doesn't sound too strange. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it right for you. I just want to be helpful.
Sometimes people repeat words or actions they hear or see others do, like echoing sounds or copying movements. Does that happen to you sometimes?

Um... no, not really. I mean, I know I just mentioned doing the forklift beeps and the driver signals, but that's... that's just me trying to be safe and help out with the machines, you know? I definitely don't go around repeating what my coworkers say or... or copying their movements like a parrot or anything weird like that. 

That would be really rude and annoying, and I try so hard to be polite and not bother anyone on the floor. I want people to like working with me. So, no, I don't echo people. 

I hope that makes sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers and being helpful. Am I doing okay?
Have you ever held a specific posture, like keeping your arms in one position for a long time, even when you didn’t have to, or found yourself staring into space for extended periods?

Um, well... I guess I might zone out sometimes? But, you know, just for a minute or two, like anyone does when they're tired after a long shift. 

I definitely don't stand around like a statue or stare at the wall for hours or anything like that. I know you're probably asking because of what I said earlier about pausing by the forklift with my arms up, but that's really just me being careful and trying to direct traffic, not me getting stuck in a weird pose. I wouldn't want you to think I was just standing around doing nothing while everyone else is working so hard. I try to be a really good worker.

So, no, I don't hold weird postures for a long time. I just take normal little breaks to catch my breath. 

Does that sound okay? I hope I'm explaining things clearly enough for you. I'm really trying to be as helpful as I can.
Outside of work at the warehouse, do you ever find yourself repeating words or sounds you hear, or copying movements you see someone else doing?

Oh, um... no. Definitely not outside of work. Like, if I'm at the grocery store or just out and about, I wouldn't ever do anything like that. 

I know how to behave in public, you know? I wouldn't want to make anyone uncomfortable or... or seem rude by copying what they're saying or doing. I just try to blend in and be a normal, polite guy. I mostly just keep to myself when I'm not at the warehouse anyway, maybe just read a little since I used to take some college classes. 

I really hope you don't think I'm going around bothering strangers on the street... I promise I'm really respectful of others. I wouldn't do anything to upset anyone. 

Does that... does that answer your question okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information and doing a good job here.
Have you ever intentionally held a posture or position for a long time, even when you didn’t have to, such as keeping your arms in one position or standing still for no clear reason?

Um... no, sir. I think... didn't you just ask me about that? I'm sorry, I don't mean to question you, I know you're the doctor and you have to ask these things for a reason. But yeah, like I was saying before, I definitely don't just stand around frozen or hold my arms out for no reason. 

I mean, sometimes if my back is hurting from lifting boxes all day, I might stretch and hold a stretch for a little bit? Just to loosen up the muscles. But that's normal, right? That's not what you mean by standing still for no reason. I always have a reason, like trying not to pull a muscle so I can keep working hard. 

I wouldn't want anyone to think I'm just acting strange or being lazy on purpose. I try really hard to do everything the right way. I hope it's okay that I repeated myself a little bit there... I'm doing my best to give you what you need. Is this going alright?
When you're around other people, do you ever feel a strong urge to repeat the words they say or copy the movements they make, even if you don’t want to?

Um... no, sir. I really don't. I know you asked something kind of like this just a minute ago, about copying people? And, um, it's the same answer, I promise. I never get an urge to do that. 

I mean, if my supervisor gives me instructions at the warehouse, I might repeat it back just to make sure I heard him right, so I don't mess up the freight order. But that's just me being thorough and trying to do a good job, you know? It's not like an urge I can't control or anything weird like that. 

I really hope I didn't say something earlier that made you think I go around mocking people or copying them against my will. I'd hate for you to think I'm that kind of person. I always try to be respectful of everyone. 

Did I... did I explain that okay? I'm so sorry if I'm making you repeat your questions because I'm doing a bad job explaining things. I really am trying my absolute best to give you the answers you need.

Even if you don’t plan to do it or don’t want to, do you ever find yourself automatically repeating words people say around you or copying their movements, like how someone might echo a sound or copy a gesture without meaning to?

Um... no, sir. I really don't. I... I know you've asked me about this a few times now, and I'm really sorry if I'm not giving you the answer you're looking for. I promise I'm not trying to be difficult or hide anything from you. 

I just... I don't ever find myself echoing people or copying their gestures without meaning to. I'm always in control of what I'm doing and saying. I try really hard to pay attention to my surroundings and be polite. 

I'm starting to worry that maybe I did something like that just now, without realizing it? Did I repeat something you said? If I did, I am so, so sorry. I didn't mean to, I swear. I'm just a little nervous and trying really hard to focus on your questions so I can be helpful.

Um... well... I guess... I mean, I know we've been talking about this a lot, and I really don't want you to think I'm doing things on purpose to be difficult. But, um, I suppose that's actually kind of why they brought me in here. 

I didn't want to say it before because I know it sounds bad, and I really, really try to just do my job right. But sometimes at the warehouse... I don't really plan to do it, it just sort of happens. 

And I guess I also get caught up moving the boxes in these... these little patterns, even when my supervisor and the guys are yelling at me to stop and just load the pallets. I know it slows things down, and I feel terrible about it. I really don't want them to think I'm a bad worker or that I'm ignoring them. 

I'm so sorry I didn't just tell you that right away. I was just really embarrassed, and I wanted you to see that I'm trying my best to be a good employee and a good patient. Is it... is it okay that I finally told you? I hope I didn't ruin everything by holding that back. I'm really trying to do this the right way for you now.

Did I... did I answer that okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the right information, since I messed up before. I promise I'm not trying to hide anything this time.
